title: 需要重画的电路：短接线
statement: 图示网络中，R1 = 3 Ω，R2 = 6 Ω，R3 = 6 Ω 画成一排，但下方的导线把端子 a 和 R2、R3 之间的点连在一起，上方的导线把 R1、R2 之间的点和端子 b 连在一起。
先找出各电阻两端分别是哪个结点，再求 R_ab。

questions.ask: R1、R2、R3 三个电阻的连接关系是？
choices: 三者都接在 a、b 之间，互相并联
R1 与 R3 串联后再与 R2 并联
R2 被短路，R1 与 R3 并联
questions.explain: R1：左端是 a，右端经上方导线接到 b；R2：左端是 b，右端经下方导线接到 a；R3：左端是 a，右端是 b。三个电阻都跨接在 a、b 之间，所以是并联。

hints: 用导线直接相连的点是同一个结点。给每个结点起名（a 或 b），把它写在每个电阻的两端。
如果每个电阻的两端都是 a 和 b，它们就是并联。
solution: **1. 标结点。** 端子 a 与下方导线、R2 和 R3 之间的点是同一结点 a；R1 和 R2 之间的点经上方导线与端子 b 是同一结点 b。
**2. 看每个电阻。** R1：a–b；R2：b–a；R3：a–b。三个电阻都跨在 a、b 之间——**并联**。
**3. 重画。** 把 a、b 画成两条竖线，三个电阻并排连在中间。

en.title: Redrawing a circuit with shorting wires
statement: In the network, R1 = 3 Ω, R2 = 6 Ω and R3 = 6 Ω are drawn in a row, but the lower wire joins terminal a to the point between R2 and R3, and the upper wire joins the point between R1 and R2 to terminal b.
First find which node each resistor end is on, then find R_ab.

questions.ask: How are R1, R2 and R3 connected?
choices: All three are connected between a and b, i.e. in parallel
R1 in series with R3, then in parallel with R2
R2 is shorted; R1 is in parallel with R3
questions.explain: R1: left end a, right end tied to b by the upper wire; R2: left end b, right end tied to a by the lower wire; R3: left end a, right end b. All three span a and b, so they are in parallel.

hints: Points joined by a plain wire are the same node. Name every node (a or b) and write the names at both ends of each resistor.
If every resistor has a and b at its two ends, they are all in parallel.
solution: **1. Label the nodes.** Terminal a, the lower wire and the point between R2 and R3 form node a; the point between R1 and R2 and terminal b (joined by the upper wire) form node b.
**2. Each resistor.** R1: a–b; R2: b–a; R3: a–b. All three span a and b — they are **in parallel**.
**3. Redraw.** Draw a and b as two vertical rails with the three resistors side by side between them.
